QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_26

question.text: Under the change-of-control exit mechanism for a CLOSE-ENDED Cat III AIF, the exit price for dissenting investors is:

answer.text: Not less than the average of two independent valuations

explanation.text: The Logic: Prior to buyout of dissenting investors' units, valuation is done by 2 independent valuers; the exit price is NOT LESS THAN the AVERAGE of the two valuations. The Trap: Book value (B) ignores market value. NAV at cut-off (C) is ambiguous in close-ended illiquid contexts. Hurdle-plus-subscription (D) is Cat I/II waterfall language — wrong. Note: The workbook fixes the two-valuer/average exit-price rule and the 3-month completion window; valuer-capacity planning advice is not part of the syllabus.
